## 主张 Claim

36名婴儿的1,508次公开命名记录中，三秒窗口有467次记录到其他物体注视而无所指注视；35名婴儿出现此情况。它限制命名自动确保所指注视的测量对应。 / Among 1,508 public naming records from 36 infants, 467 nominal three-second windows contain other-object gaze with zero target gaze; 35 infants show such cases. This limits automatic naming-to-target-gaze measurement correspondence.

Canonical source: [README.md](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/inquiry-correspondence/naming-attention/README.md)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 采用原作者公开分数与窗口，保留全部记录；注视是有限访问代理，不是全部光学可见性、候选表征或学习结果。 / Use the deposited fractions and windows with every record retained. Gaze is a limited access proxy, not full optical visibility, represented candidates or learning outcomes.
- 已知论文结论后作探索性复算；七个窗口是相同经历的重复测量。参与者均值另列，不将各事件当独立样本推断。 / Exploratory reanalysis with the paper’s conclusion already known. Seven windows repeatedly measure the same events; participant means are separate, without independent-event inference.
- 未将目标加其他注视归一化；无已编码物体注视、缩短窗口和小数舍入差异保留。 / No renormalization to target-plus-other gaze; zero coded-object gaze, shortened windows and decimal rounding differences remain.

所指由观察编码界定；不能将此标签当作学习者已知答案。命名、朝向及物体位置是同一互动中的关系，实际保留与纠正未由这些字段测量。 / The intended target is observer-coded and cannot be assumed as the learner’s known answer. Naming, orientation and object positions are relations within one interaction; these fields do not measure retention or correction.

## 检验与边界 Validation and boundaries

8份原始文件匹配OSF哈希；七窗口的八类计数及参与者统计以独立Decimal算法复算通过。实质作者反审完成；无新实验、独立agent验收或新Lean定理。 / Eight original files match OSF hashes. An independent Decimal calculation verifies eight count categories and participant statistics across seven windows. Substantive author counterreview completed; no new experiment, independent-agent acceptance or new Lean theorem.

不识别错误学习、独占算法、社会协调的发育因果、意识或演化心理；不是论文全部分析的精确复现，也不更改既有条件定理。 / Does not identify mislearning, a unique algorithm, developmental causation of coordination, consciousness or evolutionary psychology. Not an exact replication of all published analyses and does not change existing conditional theorems.

- 五秒窗口仍有393次其他注视而无所指注视；三秒另45次两者皆零，不能算为已观察到的错误所指。论文与导出数据的分箱／计数对应仍未解决。 / At five seconds, 393 windows still contain other gaze with zero target gaze. A separate 45 three-second windows have zero on both and cannot be counted as observed wrong reference. Publication/export binning and count correspondence remains unresolved.
